skills.description: Logs a message to the bot's output and optionally sends it as a chat message
Automatically places a torch at the bot's current position if conditions are met
Equips the bot with the weapon that has the highest attack damage from its inventory, prioritizing swords and axes, then pickaxes and shovels if no primary weapons are available
Attempt to craft the given item name from a recipe. May craft many items.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the recipe was crafted, false otherwise.

skills.description: Puts 1 coal/charcoal in furnace and smelts the given item name, waits until the furnace runs out of fuel or input items.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the item was smelted, false otherwise. Fail

skills.description: Clears the nearest furnace of all items.
skills.parameters: @param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the furnace was cleared, false otherwise.

skills.description: Attack mob of the given type.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the mob was attacked, false if the mob type was not found.

skills.description: Attack mob of the given type.
skills.parameters:
@param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
@param {Entity} entity, the entity to attack.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the entity was attacked, false if interrupted

skills.description: Defend yourself from all nearby hostile mobs until there are no more.
skills.parameters:
@param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
@param {number} range, the range to look for mobs. Defaults to 8.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the bot found any enemies and has killed them, false if no entities were found.

skills.description: Collect one of the given block type.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the block was collected, false if the block type was not found.

skills.description: Pick up all nearby items.
skills.parameters: @param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the items were picked up, false otherwise.

skills.description: Break the block at the given position. Will use the bot's equipped item.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the block was broken, false otherwise.

skills.description: Place the given block type at the given position. It will build off from any adjacent blocks. Will fail if there is a block in the way or nothing to build off of.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the block was placed, false otherwise.

skills.description: Equip the given item to the given body part, like tools or armor.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the item was equipped, false otherwise.

skills.description: Discard the given item.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the item was discarded, false otherwise.

skills.description: Eat the given item. If no item is given, it will eat the first food item in the bot's inventory.
skills.parameters:
@param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
@param {string} item, the item to eat.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the item was eaten, false otherwise.

skills.description: Give one of the specified item to the specified player
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the item was given, false otherwise.

skills.description: Navigate to the given position.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the position was reached, false otherwise.

skills.description: Navigate to the given player.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the player was found, false otherwise.

skills.description: Follow the given player endlessly. Will not return until the code is manually stopped.
skills.parameters:
@param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
@param {string} username, the username of the player to follow.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the player was found, false otherwise.

skills.description: Move away from current position in any direction.
skills.parameters:
@param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
@param {number} distance, the distance to move away.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the bot moved away, false otherwise.

skills.description: Move a given distance away from all nearby enemy mobs.
skills.parameters:
@param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
@param {number} distance, the distance to move away.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the bot moved away, false otherwise.

skills.description: Stay in the current position until interrupted. Disables all modes.
skills.parameters: @param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the bot stayed, false otherwise.

skills.description: Use the door at the given position.
skills.parameters:
@param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
@param {Vec3} door_pos, the position of the door to use. If null, the nearest door will be used.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the door was used, false otherwise.

skills.description: Sleep in the nearest bed.
skills.parameters: @param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the bed was found, false otherwise.

skills.description: Till the ground at the given position and plant the given seed type.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the ground was tilled, false otherwise.

skills.description: Activate the nearest block of the given type.
skills.parameters:
@param {MinecraftBot} bot, reference to the minecraft bot.
@param {string} type, the type of block to activate.
skills.returns: @returns {Promise<boolean>} true if the block was activated, false otherwise.
